title: Fleet replacement funding and water corporation response
subtitle: Closed-session City facility funding negotiations, provincial water consultation, and a scholarship recognition for a City staff member.
overview: Council pre-approved funding from the Fleet Equipment Reserve to replace three vehicles that failed before reaching their expected lifecycle. The purchase covers a used motor grader and two trackless municipal tractors with winter and summer equipment, all from sole source providers {{vote:m1}}. These machines support road and sidewalk maintenance, including winter operations.

After a closed session, Council authorized staff to proceed with negotiations on a City facility funding matter, under the direction Council gave in closed session. If those negotiations succeed, the General Manager of Infrastructure Services may sign the necessary documents, in a form satisfactory to the City Solicitor {{vote:m3}}. Council also authorized staff to respond to the provincial Environmental Registry of Ontario posting on a proposed Water and Wastewater Public Corporation model {{vote:m4}}.

The meeting also recognized a City committee coordinator who received an Association of Municipal Clerks and Treasurers of Ontario equity scholarship for its Executive Diploma in Municipal Management. No delegations registered to speak.

decisions.detail: Council pre-approved $831,978 from the Fleet Equipment Reserve to replace three assets that failed early, with sole source purchases of a used motor grader and two trackless municipal tractors.

Council authorized staff to proceed with negotiations as outlined in the report and Council's closed-session direction, with the General Manager of Infrastructure Services able to sign documents if negotiations succeed.

decisions.item: Water and wastewater public corporation consultation
decisions.detail: Council authorized staff to provide a response to the Environmental Registry of Ontario posting on the Water and Wastewater Public Corporation model.

debate: The transcript records no substantive debate on the fleet funding, the City facility funding matter or the water corporation response. Each was moved, called for discussion and carried without recorded comments.
No delegations were registered for the meeting, so no public concerns were presented. Written comments received before the meeting were circulated to Council.
The only procedural discussion was the Mayor's note that the closed-session agenda included an added reason, information belonging to the municipality that has monetary value, for one item.
